case: #248 phase 2 slice: extent-tree structure - level-preserving rebuild, balanced packing, exact file bound
status: PASS (focused external traversal tests); the public 4,097-write Exec/Commit gate is NOT RUN
kind: focused external test over the real page codec and the same traversal the mounted path uses, in an in-memory page store; no mount, no Commit, no timed phase

defects_found_and_fixed.hard_refusal_at_249_leaves: pack() filled each branch greedily (248 then the remainder), so 249 leaf pages packed as [248, 1]; encode_pieces_branch refuses a branch with fewer than two children and the splice returned Capacity. Every leaf count congruent to one modulo 248 (249, 497, 745, ...) could not be written. pack_level() now balances chunk sizes (249 -> 125 + 124).
defects_found_and_fixed.malformed_tree_above_two_levels: descend() answered with its collected children, one level below the node it replaced, so a splice into a tree with a root at level 2 returned a frontier that mixed shared level-1 subtrees with folded level-0 leaves; the rebuild relabelled from level 1 and the cursor then refused the tree (levels are relative). Reproduced at 65,536 one-byte extents (529 leaves): the splice succeeded and the following walk failed with Io. descend() now returns pages that all declare the replaced node's own level and each branch packs its rebuilt children up to that level.
defects_found_and_fixed.exact_4_gib_bound: PieceRecord::parse accepted offset+length only to 2^32-1 while MAX_FILE is exactly 2^32, so the last record of a full 4 GiB base read failed to parse and the whole sequence was unreadable. Now bounded by MAX_FILE.
defects_found_and_fixed.remaining_refusal: a fold that replaces an entire sibling subtree with a single page leaves that child below its own level; the splice now refuses with Capacity instead of publishing a non-uniform tree. Sibling rebalancing (borrow/merge) is remaining #248 work.
